blurb: Community involvement should be at the heart of any small business. At Hops & Grain we are committed to being a good neighbor, not only to our planet but also to our neighborhood community. At both of our breweries we connect with other local businesses and non-profits to bring attention to what makes central Texas great, the creative men and women that live and work here!
